translations.web: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”
translations.bsb: Who knows if the spirit of man rises upward and the spirit of the animal descends into the earth?
translations.kjv: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?
translations.asv: Who knoweth the spirit of man, whether it goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast, whether it goeth downward to the earth?
